data.name: NoValueDetailAbsent
data.value: No signature headers were present in the request

data.name: NoValueDetailNotSent
data.value: The signature did not carry this information

data.name: NoValueDetailMalformed
data.value: The signature headers could not be read

data.name: NoValueDetailWrongTag
data.value: No signature in the request was made for automated agent traffic

data.name: NoValueDetailNoAgent
data.value: The signature named no agent, so there was nowhere to fetch a key from

data.name: NoValuePurposeNotRead
data.value: The signature was not verified so the directory was not read

data.name: NoValuePurposeNotStated
data.value: The agent does not say what its keys are for

data.name: NoValueNoCard
data.value: No agent card available

data.name: LogDirectoryFetchFailed
data.value: The key directory at '{0}' could not be read because {1}. The request reports the Unverified status, which is not evidence against the agent.

data.name: LogReachabilityGood
data.value: Agent signature verification reached the key directory at '{0}' at start up, so this deployment can fetch the keys agents publish.

data.name: LogReachabilityBad
data.value: Agent signature verification could NOT reach the key directory at '{0}' at start up because {1}. Unless outbound HTTPS is opened for this deployment, every signed request will report the Unverified status with the DirectoryUnavailable reason, because no agent's keys can be fetched. Signature checking is effectively switched off until this is fixed.

data.name: LogCardFetchFailed
data.value: The agent card at '{0}' could not be read because {1}. The signature status is unaffected.

data.name: LogRegistryFetchFailed
data.value: The agent card registry at '{0}' could not be read because {1}. The signature status is unaffected.

data.name: LogMillisecondKeyTimes
data.value: The key directory at '{0}' carried key times in milliseconds where the standard uses seconds, so the times were divided by 1,000.

data.name: LogDirectoryPending
data.value: The key directory at '{0}' had not been fetched after {1}ms, so this request reports the Timeout status. The fetch keeps running, so a later request from this agent finds the result.

data.name: LogSharedSecretAlgorithm
data.value: A request was signed with the shared secret algorithm '{0}' using key id '{1}'. The Web Bot Auth protocol forbids shared secrets, so the signature was not verified. This points at a misconfigured agent and is worth an operator's attention.

data.name: NoValueDetailUnbound
data.value: The signature covered nothing that ties it to this request, so it was not checked.

data.name: NoValueDetailInlineDirectory
data.value: The agent sent its key with the request rather than publishing it, which this element does not accept.

data.name: ExceptionPeriodOutOfRange
data.value: The period must not be negative and must not be longer than {0}.

data.name: ExceptionCacheSizeTooSmall
data.value: The cache must be allowed to hold at least one key directory.

data.name: ExceptionMaxResponseBytesTooSmall
data.value: The response limit must allow at least one byte to be read.
